labels.label: rem:morphisms_analytical_two_equal

hypotheses.note: PreconnectedSpace M, which is what DEC-42's 'connected' amounts to once the open set is nonempty

findings: l.491 is false as written (recorded by DEC-42): it needs a nonempty open set (GX.analytic_counterexample_empty) and M connected (GX.analytic_counterexample_disconnected, R ⊕ R with translations). Closed under DEC-42's reading; both counterexamples are kept in the file.

labels.label: lem:aepullback

hypotheses.paper: unique a.e. structure (DEC-42: identified with its maximal atlas, l.471)
hypotheses.note: GX.aepullback: existence of an a.e. atlas making f an a.e. morphism, any two such have the same maximal atlas (SameAEStructure), and the maximal one is unique (ExistsUnique)
IsAELocalHomeomorph, read from the proof's first line (SCOPE (e))

findings: l.545 'unique a.e. (G,X)-structure' is false among arbitrary a.e. atlases (GX.aePullback_counterexample_nonmaximal: two distinct a.e. atlases on R make id an a.e. morphism); under DEC-42 (unique up to maximal atlas) it closes. Counterexample kept.

labels.label: lem:GX_atlas_union
findings: l.412: for an empty family the union is the empty atlas, not an a.e. atlas on a nonempty space (GX.not_isAEAtlas_iUnion_empty). Unchanged; no ruling yet settles it (a one-line ruling 'K nonempty' would close the row with the existing proof).
questions: Does the author rule the family nonempty in lem:GX_atlas_union (its only use, cor:maximal_atlas, has a nonempty family)? If so the row closes as is.

labels.label: prop:GX_sing_morph_local
questions: 'f is locally an a.e. morphism' and 'f|U is an a.e. morphism' are not defined in the paper: read as IsAEMorphismOn (some subset portly in W on which f induces a (G,X)-morphism for the ambient atlases), 'locally' = around every point on an open W (SCOPE (d)). DEC-42's identification does not settle this reading; a ruling accepting it would close the row. New: the singular-manifold form GX.isAEMorphism_tfae.

labels.label: rem:though_may_tempted_include
questions: An informal remark; read as 0 ∉ Reg(z ↦ z^p) for p ≠ 1 whatever the a.e. atlases on C (SCOPE (g)); the sentence about Riemann surfaces is not formalizable as stated. No ruling covers it; unchanged.

labels.label: cor:locally_connected_hausdorff_topological

hypotheses.note: aePullback_comp_of_exists asks only that the left side be defined (some maximal atlases make g and f a.e. morphisms) and then yields existence of (g∘f)^*A; aePullback_comp asks the a.e.-local-homeomorphism hypotheses of lem:aepullback

hypotheses.paper: L, M, N Hausdorff; M, N locally connected

findings: l.558 states no hypothesis making g^*A and f^*g^*A defined (def:notations_lemma_lem_aepullback defines f^* only under lem:aepullback's hypotheses). Now proved under the weakest such hypothesis, 'the left side is defined' (GX.aePullback_comp_of_exists).
questions: Does the author accept 'whenever g^*A and f^*g^*A are defined' as the corollary's implicit hypothesis (it is forced by the notation of l.554)? If so the row closes with GX.aePullback_comp_of_exists; no current ruling (DEC-42 included) says so, so the row stays partial (SCOPE (e')).

kb_proposals: DEC-42's identification is GX.SameAEStructure (equal maximalAEAtlas); an a.e. morphism for an a.e. atlas is one for its maximal atlas (IsAEMorphismOf.maximalAEAtlas_left), so any a.e. atlas making f an a.e. morphism has maximal atlas aePullback G B f (IsAEMorphismOf.maximalAEAtlas_eq_aePullback).
